invite: Do you want to start a quick tutorial?
detail: Make a small composition with {{brandName}}, from your first effect to a video export. A separate practice project will open.
leaveDetail: Your practice project will stay available. You can replay the tutorial from editor preferences.
error: This action failed. Please try again.

errors.changedStart: The active project changed. Start the tutorial again.
errors.imagesImport: The tutorial images could not be imported.
errors.notReady: This control is not ready. Try Next again.
errors.exportFailed: Video export did not complete. Try exporting again.
errors.imageMenu: Could not open the image menu.
errors.effectLibrary: Could not open the effect library.
errors.restoreSurface: Could not restore the tutorial surface.

canvas.title: Your canvas
canvas.text: This is your canvas. Add images, videos, text and objects here. We have loaded three images for you.

tools.title: Your tools
tools.text: Use the toolbar to select, move, draw and add content. You can also pan with your trackpad and zoom around the pointer with {zoom}.

properties.title: Properties
properties.text: On the right, change the selected object's size, appearance and effects.

layers.title: Layers
layers.text: Layers control the stacking order. Select the middle image, {{lake}}, in this list.

effectMenu.title: Open the effect menu
effectMenu.text: Click {add} at the top of Layers. The guide will follow you into the effect menu.

effectCategory.title: Add an effect
effectCategory.text: Click {effects} in this menu to open the effect library.

dither.title: Try Dither
dither.text: The search is ready. Click {dither} to turn the image into a pattern of dots.

recenter.title: Back to your canvas
recenter.text: Dither is applied. We have zoomed out and recentered the canvas so you can see the whole composition.

modes.title: Static and Motion
modes.text: {static} is for still compositions. {motion} adds animation and video playback. The switch lives below your artboard.

motion.title: Make it move
motion.text: We have zoomed in on the switch. Click {motion} to enable animation. We will look at the timeline after adding a transition.

context.title: Right-click your image
context.text: The canvas is centered again. Use {rightClick} on the middle image, {{lake}}, to open its actions.

transition.title: Add a transition
transition.text: Choose {animation} in this context menu to open the animation library.

pop.title: Add a pop
pop.text: Click {pop} in the Scale category to give the image a short pop-in entrance.

pin.title: Pin the timeline
pin.text: Click {pin} to keep the timeline open. You can resize it; the guide will follow the controls.

timeline.title: Your timeline
timeline.text: Each row represents a layer. The clips show when it appears, and the Pop clip is its animation. Drag the playhead to inspect a moment; the controls on the left set playback and duration.

play.title: Play
play.text: Press {play} in the timeline to preview your animation.

export.title: Export
export.text: Open {export} at the top right. We will export the motion as a video.

exportWindow.title: The export window
exportWindow.text: Choose your artboard and output on the left. Preview the result on the right. Resolution and format control the file you download.

video.title: Motion video
video.text: Choose {video} in the export window. Keep the default video settings.

render.title: Save your video
render.text: Click {exportVideo}. {{brandName}} will render the actual animation and download it. The render and download continue independently.

ready.title: You're ready
ready.text: You've completed the tutorial. {{brandName}} handles the video render and download in the background; you can keep working.
